$comment: Canonical catalog of the 14 Stations of the Cross, in order. imageKey doubles as the lookup key into StationsTranslations (title/meditation per language) and the filename stem under Shared/Images/{imageKey}. Source of truth: iOS's Models/StationsCatalog.swift (this file was built from it); Android's models/StationsCatalog.kt and Windows's Models/StationsCatalog.cs must carry the exact same set/order. Keep in sync — see README.md in this directory.

images.note: All 14 station images currently point at a generic placeholder graphic (violet cross), not real artwork — real public-domain art with proper attribution has not been sourced yet. See each platform's About screen, which labels these explicitly as 'artwork pending' rather than citing fake attributions.

languages.note: ar/he/ru/tl fall back to Latin via the standard translation-dispatcher fallback (same mechanism as any missing content-layer entry) until dedicated translations are added in a later pass.

stations.title: Simon of Cyrene Helps Jesus Carry the Cross
Veronica Wipes the Face of Jesus
Jesus Meets the Women of Jerusalem
Jesus is Stripped of His Garments
Jesus is Nailed to the Cross
Jesus is Taken Down from the Cross
Jesus is Laid in the Tomb

sharedPrayerKeys.$comment: Reused across all 14 stations rather than one key per station — see content-keys.json.
